title: Enable XMP / EXPO RAM Profile
name: xmp-expo-ram
modal: WARNING: Your PC will restart IMMEDIATELY into the BIOS/UEFI setup. Save all work first. Enable XMP (Intel), EXPO (AMD) or DOCP (ASUS), then Save and Exit. Do not change anything else.
description: Checks if RAM runs below rated speed and reboots to BIOS to enable XMP/EXPO for full memory speed
deepDescription:
This detects whether your RAM runs slower than its rated speed (XMP/EXPO off). Windows cannot flip the profile itself, so this tweak reboots you straight into BIOS. Enable there:

- Intel boards → XMP Profile 1
- AMD boards → EXPO Profile 1
- ASUS boards → DOCP

Full RAM speed gives more FPS, especially on Ryzen.
warning: PC restarts immediately. Save your work first.
